open_bounded_vetoes.finding: SelfOriginEvidenceChain still accepts trust and anchor_alignment as free ExperienceEvidence fields and only checks appraisal_binding_hash is non-empty. It does not validate those values against canonical DerivedAppraisal bytes/ref. A forged caller can therefore supply high trust/alignment plus any non-empty binding string and potentially satisfy the self-origin evaluator if the remaining verification envelope is otherwise acceptable.

Historical origin remains immutable; STABLE_CANDIDATE must be a new derived object, never relabel-in-place.

open_bounded_vetoes.finding: The new external monotonic anchor is optional. When trusted_anchor_root is omitted, verify() falls back to workspace-local ledger + accepted_head only; rolling both files back to an older valid pair remains undetectable. Therefore the repair is architecturally sound only when the independently retained anchor is mandatory for any live Small-Nest/formal-adoptable ledger mode.
open_bounded_vetoes.required_change: Split research-local mode from live/formal mode. Live/formal constructor or integration adapter must fail closed unless trusted_anchor_root and a trusted workspace/installation identity are supplied by an independently retained reconciler/installation authority. The unbound fallback may exist only as explicit TEST/RESEARCH mode and must be ineligible for promotion evidence.
